note: Break ideas shown on the take-a-break page. Shared by every Lumio Guard client. No links, no feeds. Faith-oriented ideas are kept in a separate file and only shown when faith mode is on (not built yet).

activities.title: Stand up and stretch
activities.detail: Reach for the ceiling, roll your shoulders, and loosen your neck for one minute.

activities.title: Take a short walk
activities.detail: Walk around the house or compound for five minutes, without your phone.

activities.title: Get a glass of water
activities.detail: Drink it slowly somewhere away from the screen.

activities.title: Draw something near you
activities.detail: Pick any object in the room and sketch it for five minutes. It doesn't need to be good.

activities.title: Write five lines
activities.detail: A short story, a song verse, or just what is on your mind today.

activities.title: Talk to someone at home
activities.detail: Ask them how their day is going, and really listen.

activities.title: Help with one small thing
activities.detail: Wash a plate, fold some clothes, or carry something for someone.

activities.title: Rest your eyes
activities.detail: Look out of a window at something far away for a full minute.

activities.title: Breathe slowly
activities.detail: Breathe in for four counts and out for four counts, ten times.

activities.title: Read two pages
activities.detail: Pick up a book or your notes and read just two pages.

activities.title: Chase one question
activities.detail: Think of something you have always wondered about and write the question down to look up later.

activities.title: Ask yourself one thing
activities.detail: What did I come online to do, and have I done it?
